sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The objective of this scheme is to support the education of girls who have lost their fathers and are studying in government schools. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹350/- to ₹450/- are provided to eligible girls from Class 1 to Class 12.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Scholarships and student finance
**Where it applies:** Madhya Pradesh; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Scholarship for Fatherless Girls&quot; scheme was launched by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, to support the education of girls who have lost their fathers and are studying in government schools. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹350/- to ₹450/- are provided to eligible girls from Class 1 to Class 12. To be eligible, girls students should not be beneficiaries of any other scholarship and must have passed their previous class.

**Benefits / Assistance:** Under this scheme, the scholarships will be given at the following rates:- - **Class 1 to 5:** ₹350/- per year - **Class 6 to 8:** ₹400/- per year - **Class 9 to 12:** ₹450/- per year **Note:** The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student&#39;s bank account.

**Application Process:** - To avail of the benefits under this scheme, eligible girl students can contact the Principal of their respective government schools/institutions. **Note:** The student&#39;s profile is entered on the education portal [https://shikshaportal.mp.gov.in/](https://shikshaportal.mp.gov.in/) by the teacher of the educational institution as per the record/certificate provided by the student.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: School Education Department, Government Of Madhya Pradesh; Nodal Department: School Education Department
